scope.description: Implement and validate a separate C++/HTSlib Python-v2-compatible 50 kb regional sSNV topology endpoint for full HCC1395 autosomes, including deterministic parallel execution, fail-closed validation, frozen provenance, semantic parity and controlled performance evidence.

assumptions: The compatibility endpoint is descriptive/evaluation-only and cannot replace the formal M2/topology claim endpoint.
Python-v2 L0/L1 counts are independent of post-tree SEQC2 CN annotation; production-compatible output therefore reports CN/LOH as unavailable.
Exact parity requires region, selected-locus, HP-family and supported-pattern membership equality, not only the aggregate 8222-region count.
The frozen raw BAM plus authoritative truth-free HP/PS sidecar is the input authority; truth-bearing persisted tagged BAM is evaluation-only.

step_verify.step: Freeze the Python-v2 regional contract and negative cases.
step_verify.verify: Audit and ADR identify exact 50 kb grouping, first-tie densest-8 cap, HP-family mapping, minimum-three pattern support, legacy cap semantics and claim boundary.

step_verify.step: Implement C++/HTSlib extraction, legacy solver and deterministic worker ordering.
step_verify.verify: Synthetic unit and integration tests pass at workers 1 and 4 with identical semantic SHA and expected negative exits.

step_verify.step: Replay frozen Python HCC1395 intermediate artifacts.
step_verify.verify: Zero mismatch for region keys, selected loci, HP-family supported patterns, unit class and exact integer counts before any BAM full run.

step_verify.step: Run full HCC1395 with 24 workers plus a same-input bounded one/24-worker determinism probe.
step_verify.verify: The full run validates and freezes with exact Python-v2 aggregate and membership parity; the bounded one/24-worker TSV artifacts are byte-identical.

step_verify.step: Publish controlled performance and HTML evidence.
step_verify.verify: Measured wall/RSS/thread counts and scope-matched Python baseline are explicitly separated from estimates and formal-topology timings.

evidence.output_excerpt: Portable and Playwright QA passed 19 blocks, one chart, seven tables, one visible H1, explicit descriptive/non-production PARTIAL ribbon, zh-Hant language, 1440/390/print, zero external requests/errors/overflow and keyboard source-dialog access.
Preserved historical receipt: 100% tests passed, 0 failed out of 46; regional_compat and regional_compat_validator both passed. This is not current-source validation.
Cold start, policy, state, catalog, status codes, 30 required gates and truth boundary all passed; the regional parity gate has a unique executable negative binding.

deviations: The task draft requested full workers=1 and workers=24 BAM runs. The full validated run used workers=24; deterministic parallelism was tested on the same first 100 BAM regions with workers=1 and 24 and byte-identical regions/units/patterns TSVs. A redundant full workers=1 NFS scan was not represented as completed.

Repository policy forbids a new Python science rerun. The frozen historical Python duration is a four-sample scheduler observation rather than an isolated timer, and the validated C++ run used warm NFS cache; therefore the apparent 17.023x ratio is reported only as an observation with full_controlled_claim_allowed=false.

The first full workers=24 C++ candidate matched aggregate classes but differed in two capped display-only n_hidden/n_trees fields. It was not frozen. CPython 3.9 set merge/copy table behavior was then reproduced, two golden edge cases were added, and the final run has zero mismatch in all compared fields.

The shared portable renderer initially rejected the report for horizontal overflow. The final presentation-only deliverer adds a scrollbar-safe full-bleed top-bar width override and then reruns the canonical static-chart, desktop/mobile, source and keyboard QA; scientific artifact bytes are unaffected.

System jsonschema 3.2.0 cannot interpret Draft 2020-12 prefixItems. Its rejection was not used as evidence; the existing pinned jsonschema 4.26.0 validated all three closed compatibility schemas with zero errors.
The frozen five-file source bundle is bound by individual SHA-256 values and frozen output manifests; the historical origin commit alone is not sufficient to reconstruct that bundle.

The BAM is read on the governed host from the authoritative remote input mount, not from a separate local work-root copy. The manifest locks the raw BAM SHA-256 and pairs it with a truth-free HP/PS sidecar; no persisted truth-tagged BAM is used.

Repository-wide source-boundary and hygiene scripts retain one and thirteen pre-existing baseline failures respectively, while this change adds none. Existing unsafe history and pending license/source-origin audit prevent direct public GitHub push and remain outside this verified scientific task.

The 2026-07-22 publication repair regenerated only the presentation layer from the same frozen receipts: it removed a redundant Markdown title that produced two visible H1 headings after hydration, added a descriptive/non-production PARTIAL ribbon, and reran canonical renderer plus desktop/mobile/print QA. All artifact datasets other than the removed title block remained byte-semantic identical.
